run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Resolve 13 open SonarQube findings through non-behavioral refactors (decompose overly complex functions, dedupe literals and an identical test) plus three Dockerfile lint fixes, per the supplied PR description; no originating issue exists.
summary.issue_fit: Met — no originating issue exists, so intent is taken from the supplied PR body (spec-pr195). Every claimed change (complexity decomposition, literal/test dedup, Dockerfile cleanup) matches the diff, and the body's 'behaviour and log output unchanged' promise held under a line-by-line base/head comparison of every decomposed function.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff reviewed across all 4 changed files (docker/Dockerfile, internal/backup.go, internal/backup_test.go, internal/notify.go). go build ./..., go vet ./... and go test ./internal/ -count=1 run once at head 136a4850d (all pass; credential-gated live provider tests skip for lack of tokens, matching this run's policy). golangci-lint could not be reproduced under this run's execution allowance, so that claim is taken as the author's unverified local report.

findings.title: Drop the duplicate resetBackups() call in the Gitea orgs test loop
findings.trigger: Each iteration of TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup's org loop calls resetBackups() once inside the matched switch case (sobaOrgTwo or "*") and then calls it again, unconditionally, right after the switch closes.
findings.impact: resetBackups() is idempotent today (it opens the backup dir and removes an already-empty listing), so the second call is a harmless no-op rather than a masked ordering bug. It does read as a leftover from the refactor and can confuse a future edit into thinking the double reset is load-bearing.
findings.change: Keep exactly one resetBackups() call per iteration — drop the calls inside the two switch cases and keep the single call after the switch (or the reverse).
findings.source: Flagged in the supplied PR review thread on internal/backup_test.go:629 (copilot-pull-request-reviewer); independently reproduced against the head diff.

observations.fact: checkProvidersDefined's Bitbucket bookkeeping used to depend on Go's randomized map-iteration order in the rare case both the API-token and OAuth methods are simultaneously fully configured (the base set bitbucketAPITokenComplete only when that switch case was visited); the refactor computes bitbucketAPITokenDefined() once before the loop, which removes that latent order-dependence rather than introducing one.
observations.evidence: internal/backup.go:643-646 (head) vs the base's per-iteration mutation of bitbucketAPITokenComplete inside the loop body.

observations.fact: The 'Organistations' log-message typo noted in the supplied review thread (internal/backup.go:207) predates this change — it already appears at the merge-base in all three call sites (GitHub, Gitea, Azure DevOps) — and the diff only relocates the string into shared helpers without altering its text.
observations.evidence: git show main:internal/backup.go lines 187, 209, 275 all read "... Organistations: %s".

requirements.evidence: internal/backup.go:40-142,190-296,322-545,680-717 — each extracted helper (collectProviderBackupResults, displayGitHub/Gitea/GitLab/BitBucket/AzureDevOpsStartupConfig + logProviderOrgs/CompareMethod/BackupsToKeep/BackupLFS, checkJustTokenProvider/checkUserAndPasswordProvider, logRequestTimeout/validateStartupConfig/createWorkingDir/scheduleBackups/runScheduledJob) reproduces the base's branching, ordering and exact log strings.

internal/backup_test.go:600-683 — assertGiteaOrgTwoOnlyBackedUp/assertGiteaAllOrgsBackedUp/dirHasEntryWithPrefix assert the same directory-existence and filename-prefix checks as the base's inline switch bodies.

internal/notify.go:24-38 — titleBackupsSucceeded/Errors/Failed constants are byte-identical (verified by regex-extracting every quoted "backups ..." literal from base and head) to the six inlined copies they replace; sendTelegramMessage, sendNtfy and sendSlackMessage all now call the shared backupStatusTitle helper.
git show main:internal/backup_test.go:551-586 shows TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 was line-for-line identical to TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup before its removal at head.

docker/Dockerfile diff — the addgroup/adduser RUN now chains the apk add via && instead of a separate RUN; the package list reads bash, ca-certificates, curl, git, git-lfs, grep, jq (alphabetical); the curl download URL argument is now double-quoted around ${TAG}.

go build ./... and go vet ./... both exit 0 at head 136a4850d; go test ./internal/ -count=1 passes (ok, 5.189s) with credential-gated live provider tests (Gitea/GitHub/GitLab/BitBucket) skipping for lack of tokens, matching this run's stated policy. golangci-lint was outside this run's execution allowance (only go build/vet/test were authorized) and was not independently reproduced, so that portion of the claim stays an unverified author report.
